title: Open sourcing an NQ Compounding Trading Strategy
author: widowmakerhusband
selftext:
Whats up r/ai_trading 

  
For the past 6 months, Ive worked vigorously using frontier AI to make a perfect no look ahead bias backtesting engine, Its now working where I can throw a strategy, ask it to iterate 200 times and find something that is profitable. Ive developed a software [https://jellycharts.com](https://jellycharts.com), I used AI agents to use market data, create strategies, auto fix errors and run it in my backtesting engine. Ive created this compounding London Breakout strategy. Ive hinted to a hidden model. I will be releasing soon on my website. 

Im open sourcing this model.

This is the performance in 5 years. 

Starting Balance: 6,000 

Final balance**$39,581**

Yearly growth**46%**

Max drawdown**−24.5%**

Win rate**31.2%**

Sharpe**1.33**

Profit factor**1.22**

  
I will be releasing this on X, Jellycharts. on September 25th.

comments.author: Foreign-Safe-8161
comments.body: *Iterating 200 times until an LLM finds a 'profitable' backtest isn't alpha generation—it's industrial-grade data snooping and textbook overfitting. You are literally torturing the historical data until it confesses to a pattern that only exists in your hindsight-biased sandbox. Throwing a $6,000 account at a Nasdaq futures breakout strategy with a 24.5% paper drawdown is a fast track to a margin call in live trading, especially with the 'Hidden Model' upsell funnel attached. Stop marketing curve-fitted noise as quantitative engineering*
